description: This file defines classes and methods for dispatching Electron-related objects and interactions within the Playwright testing framework. It includes ElectronDispatcher and ElectronApplicationDispatcher, which manage Electron instance launching, browser window handling, evaluation of expressions, and event subscriptions.

classes.name: ElectronDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing Electron instances, including launching Electron apps.

classes.name: ElectronApplicationDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing an Electron application, handling events, evaluating expressions, and managing windows.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an Electron application with specified parameters, unless launching is denied.

methods.name: browserWindow
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to a browser window within the Electron application.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression within the Electron application context.

methods.name: evaluateExpressionHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: updateSubscription
methods.description: Enables or disables event subscriptions for the Electron application.

ctags.name: ElectronDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class ElectronDispatcher extends Dispatcher<Electron, channels.ElectronChannel, RootDispa/
